Chapter 7104: Missing Black Dragon

Chapter 7104: Missing Black Dragon

“Alright, no more chatting, let’s go see someone.” The baldy said and took Li Qiye to see someone.

To be exact, it was a vermillion bird with a waning fiery aura, clearly grievously injured. It got up from the bed and kneeled upon seeing Li Qiye.

“What is it?” Li Qiye frowned.

“Greetings, great immortal. I am a personal guard of Chongming Immortal Lord, the servants of the dragon race.”

“Servants of the dragons?” Li Qiye asked.

“Old man, the dragon servants are a big organization in Divine Firmament, chosen for generations. They are essentially slaves for the divine beasts.” The baldy said.

“And?” Li Qiye asked.

“I don’t know, I’m just carrying out a favor.” He shrugged.

As the bird knelt, it trembled in pain and would have died long ago without Duality Enterprise’s medicine.

“Great immortal, my lord wishes to hand you the Chongming Order.” The bird raised a badge with both hands.

“For me?” Li Qiye accepted and took a look. On the surface was a carving of a chongming bird. The other side had an ancient rune - Ming.

“The lord’s message is that what you are looking for is right in our palace.” The bird said.

“And what’s happening to your lord?” Li Qiye asked.

“We do not know, the other lords have sealed the palace. I left in a hurry.” The bird said.

“Must be something big, Chongming Bird has always been in charge after what happened with Gluttonous Beast. Her status was no less than Phoenix Queen or Skykiller.” The baldy said.

“Great immortal, please, the lord said that time was of the essence.” The bird said before vomiting blood and fainting on the ground.

“This guy, surviving based on sheer willpower.” The baldy carried the bird back to the bed.

Li Qiye left the room and the baldy followed.

“Old man, you’re going to Divine Firmament now?” He asked.

“You told me to come here for this little matter?” Li Qiye frowned.

“They wanted to see you, not me.” He became annoyed.

“Anything else?” Li Qiye asked.

“Hah... well, Black Dragon is missing.” He added.

“Missing? Didn’t he want to train in isolation?” Li Qiye asked.

“He suddenly changed his mind and left, I lost contact afterward.” The baldy said.

“If that’s the case, why do you look so guilty?” Li Qiye asked.

“I didn’t do anything.” He raised his voice.

“You know exactly what you did, you didn’t summon me over this Chongming palace matter, not with how stubborn you are.” Li Qiye said: “Speak, what did you do?”

“I don’t appreciate your attitude, don’t look at me like that, I am a dignified talent, not a troublemaking young master.” He said.

“Fine, you’re a dignified talent, but you still certainly caused trouble. Speak or I’m leaving.” Li Qiye said.

“Uhh... well, it’s nothing, really, was just an idea.” He said.

“You gave him an idea?” Li Qiye stared skeptically at him.

“And? Given my knowledge and intelligence, my ideas are amazing.” He said.

“Fine, tell me what the great idea was then.” Li Qiye said.

“An idea might be too strong, it was more of a random comment, so I take no responsibility for it.” He smiled wryly.

“What did you say?” Li Qiye asked patiently.

“What happened was, his cultivation wasn’t improving, so I told him why not return to the sea of wisdom? I wonder if that’s what he did...” He said.

“And that’s all you said?” Li Qiye inquired again.

“That’s all I did, so I’m speculating that’s what he did.” He swore.

“It’s normal for someone to disappear for a long time on the dao path.” Li Qiye said.

“Hehe, this is different because he probably went to the sea of wisdom.” He said.

“Why are you worried? It’s not his first time.” Li Qiye said.

“Well...” He couldn’t respond.

“Go on, you left out the main point.” Li Qiye smirked.

“What main point? You know that my sixth sense is incredible, so I sensed that something’s wrong for him, that’s why I called for you.” He said.

“Is your sixth sense stronger than mine?” Li Qiye asked.

“I don’t care whether your sixth sense is better or not, I’m just telling you what I feel.” He angrily said.
